measurement.note: Per-request provider usage from the retained subagent transcripts. A child counts only the assistant messages that already carry usage; for an incomplete run (status below) interrupted requests may be missing, so its totals are a lower bound. The raw output differs from this copy only in transcript_dir, which held a host path.

child_usage.reason: every child has an explicit requested model, a matching resolved model, returned usage and a non-null result
